title: Expose an opt-in first-party read-only Case Queue browser over authorized Queue HTTP
goal: Make already-authorized CAP-INV-101 native Queue list, search and pagination visible in an accessible same-origin browser without implementing Shared Inspector, a second owner model or Case mutation.
invariants: Only the current server-host-authorized Case Queue GET projection supplies rows, tenant and environment; browser never creates or supplies scope or per-object permissions.
No raw HTML injection from Case data; render cells only via textContent, no external dependency or listener token in browser assets.
Host injects current authenticated session, Case candidates and independent per-Case/Incident/Finding read authorizer.
Serve read-only no-store same-origin static assets with restrictive Content-Security-Policy, never a Case response on arbitrary asset routes.
Presentation is bounded to list/search/page and freshness; Shared Inspector UI, Workspace hosting, Saved View management, Case mutations, export and production IAM are excluded.
security_properties: No denied Case or nested sources may appear in current authorized API listing even if provider-supplied AccessDecision says allow.
Any unauthenticated API request is rejected; UI assets contain zero tenant/Case/bearer material.
A stale or denied page response clears previously rendered Case rows; no partial data cache or cross-tenant persistence.
Unsafe static UI path, method or query fails before owner provider is invoked.

migration.rationale: Opt-in same-origin host-mounted static browser with no changed persistence or Case schema

rollback.strategy: Stop using NewAuthorizedQueueBrowserHandler and use existing native authorized Queue HTTP handler
verification: Existing GET Case Queue and POST return routes remain available
No data persisted in browser or backend

inputs: CAP-INV-101 §§3/11/15/16/17/21/25, Queue Shell composition and focus/selection Shared design authority.

outputs: Opt-in GET /case-queue/ui with only local same-origin CSS and JS; query text search and cursor paging driven by authorized /case-queue JSON.
Accessible read-only Case list with status, owner, freshness, update time and current trusted host-reported scope; no Inspector clone.
acceptance_tests: Go httptest proves UI assets no-store/CSP with no leaked Case IDs, denied and unauthenticated Case API responses, current independent source ACL.
Invalid static routes/methods/queries are rejected without session/provider invocation.
Existing native Case Queue filtering/paging/Saved View/return tests pass unchanged; no new packages or API spend.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse existing <=5000 candidate owner pass and 25-row UI page. No separate search engine.
metrics: No new permission checks or provider traversals beyond existing native handler

definition_of_ready: CAP-INV-101 Class-0 read-only Queue is implemented in parent #147, no mutation required.
Browser static assets only; host must furnish real session and object ACL at runtime.
definition_of_done: Publish exact source/base/HEAD and Go native HTTP behavioral tests, verify SHA-specific CI.
Only one independent read-only L2 for material UI/API integration, do not merge draft ancestor stacks or claim full Shared Inspector UI.
